# Options Hedging under Frictions {#plan-ch22}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Studies hedging when rebalancing is discrete, costly, and itself moves the market.

**Subtopics.** Delta and gamma exposure; discrete hedging error; stochastic volatility; transaction costs; impact-aware rebalancing; inventory constraints; no-trade regions; volatility and jump risk; joint hedge and execution decisions; liquidity differences across strikes and maturities.
